settings.title: IR Remote workshop
settings.subtitle: Manage buttons, learn codes through ESPHome and keep a portable backup.
settings.global_subtitle: Configure ESPHome for IR learning and export all remotes. IR commands are transmitted by Homey Pro.
settings.debug_hint: Logs detailed MQTT and IR data such as request IDs, ProntoHex/raw codes and transmission details. Leave disabled for normal operation.
settings.ir_word_test_hint: Developer test for the Homey IR format. Sends a 1024-word test frame through the Homey Bridge selected for the remote and uses the highest word index 1023. Debug logging must be enabled.
settings.ir_word_test_success: Test frame sent: word index __index__ of __count__ words.
settings.add_remote_hint: Add or import remotes from Devices > Add Device > IR Remote.
settings.no_remotes: No IR remotes have been added yet.
settings.press_remote: Point the remote at the ESPHome receiver and press the desired button. Learning waits up to 30 seconds.
settings.import_hint: The JSON file can be imported while adding a new IR Remote device.

repair.subtitle: Add, edit, learn, test or delete the buttons of this remote.
repair.no_buttons: This remote has no buttons yet.
repair.transmitter_notice: Commands are sent by the Homey Pro IR blaster. Selecting a Homey Bridge is not supported for dynamic ProntoHex codes.
